verdict.rationale: Docs show the x402 Bazaar provides public, keyless discovery across merchants ('You do not need a CDP API key to use the discovery APIs'), automatic seller enrollment with no registration form, and buyer-side search/filtering plus MCP tool-call discovery, directly matching the story's no-partnership, self-service search requirement. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that Bazaar search actually returns usable, high-quality results across many merchants (community evidence covers building payment gateways, not the discovery/search API itself).
